```{r, packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```


## list of words

```{r, words}
words <- scan("./words.txt", what = character(), sep = ",", quote = "\"")
```

## simulating one guess

```{r, wordle_game1}
random <- sample(words, 2, replace = FALSE)
answer <- str_split(random[1], pattern="") #answer
answer
guess <- str_split(random[2], pattern="") #first guess
guess


### check if any letters / positions same as answer

reveal <- c()
answer <- as.vector(answer)

for (i in 1:5) {
  
 # check and place green
  if (guess[[1]][i] == answer[[1]][i]){
    reveal[i] = "green" 
  } else if (guess[[1]][i] %in% answer[[1]] & guess[[1]][i] != answer[[1]][i]) {
    reveal[i] = "yellow"
  } else {
    reveal[i] = "grey"
  }
}

reveal

```
